parameters.name: FilterAliUid
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to filter the results by Alibaba Cloud account ID.

Valid values:

- true: Filters the results by Alibaba Cloud account ID.

- false: Does not filter the results by Alibaba Cloud account ID.

parameters.name: ServiceId
parameters.description:
The service ID.

Call the [ListServices](~~2264368~~) operation to obtain the service ID.

parameters.name: ServiceVersion
parameters.description:
The service version.

Call the [ListServices](~~2264368~~) operation to obtain the service version.

parameters.name: SharedAccountType
parameters.description:
The service sharing type.

Valid values:

- SharedAccount (default): common sharing.

- Resell: distribution sharing.
